project_type: Multi-module cloud-ops platform: Java/Spring Boot services (xamops-service, billops, api-gateway, media-ops-service) plus a React SPA in frontend-app. This task touches frontend-app only.
language: TypeScript + React 19 (frontend-app). Java 17 elsewhere, not touched.
build_system: Vite 7 + npm in frontend-app. `npm run build` is `npm run icons:bundle && tsc && vite build`; tsconfig.json sets noEmit, strict, noUnusedLocals and noUnusedParameters, so `npx tsc` alone is the typecheck and a helper left behind after a move is a build failure, not a warning. Iconify icons are bundled by scripts/generate-icon-bundle.mjs; no new icon names are needed for this task.
test_framework: vitest 4 + @testing-library/react + jsdom, configured in frontend-app/vitest.config.ts (globals: true, setupFiles ./src/test/setup.ts, include src/**/*.{test,spec}.{ts,tsx}).
verification_instructions: Run from /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/frontend-app. (1) `npx tsc` — must be silent. (2) focused: `npx vitest run src/components/Cost/__tests__/ResourceConnectivityTab.test.tsx`. (3) Cloud Map regression: `npx vitest run src/components/CloudMap` (covers ResourceConnectivityFlow.smoke.test.tsx and connectivityFlowModel.test.ts). (4) whole suite before declaring done: `npm test`. Both test files that matter here declare a 20s per-case timeout on purpose (a 1,600-line pan/zoom canvas and a framer-motion drawer rendered through a portal, three vitest workers contending) — do not lower it. The cost drawer renders through a portal, so queries go through `screen` / `document`, not a render container.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None for this task. src/icons/bundle is generated by `npm run icons:bundle` and is only regenerated when a new icon name is introduced; this task introduces none.
environment_constraints: DO NOT create a git worktree and DO NOT commit. Work in place on branch `main`. Never run git stash, git reset, git clean, git revert, or git checkout -- <path>. An unrelated worktree exists at .worktrees/mediaops-load-hardening/ owned by another task — do not touch it. The Cost page upgrade this task builds on is already committed (c3109b8f8). .agents/tasks/connectivity-tab/review.json still holds the PREVIOUS task's "verdict": "APPROVED" and must be reset to CHANGES_REQUESTED as the very first step, because this task's review loop stops on exactly that file and value.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md and no .kiro/steering in this repo; CONTRIBUTING.md and README.md are process/setup docs with no frontend-specific rules beyond keeping the build and tests green. The binding conventions are the ones the touched files already enforce: comments explain WHY and carry the measured numbers (the real account 605134457560 'xammer-local', the EC2 instance xamops-prod-db-redis with CONNECTED TO (18) of which 16 are SSM session rows at no cost attributable); copy is honest (never $0.00 for an absence, 'no cost attributable' vs 'cost not attributable to this resource alone' vs a failed read are three different facts); Tailwind vocabulary is text-[12.5px], rgba(0,0,0,0.12) borders, #4285F4 accent, rounded-xl, shadow-sm, with #8b5cf6/#7c3aed/#ddd6fe reserved for connection edges and peer cards because the legend names those colours.
key_patterns: 1) Presentation shared by the two connectivity views is MOVED into connectivityView.tsx, never copied — its header comment states why ('a second copy is how two views of one account come to disagree about what a node is'). 2) Geometry and placement live in connectivityFlowModel.ts as pure functions (CFLOW/CCOLS constants, buildConnectivityFlow, flowEdge, trunkFor) and are unit-tested in src/components/CloudMap/__tests__/connectivityFlowModel.test.ts. 3) Every node in both views is a real focusable <button>, never a hit-test on a bitmap; an unfollowable peer is a plain <div>, NOT a disabled button, because a disabled button still answers getByRole('button', {name}). 4) react-query loading flags repeat their query's own `enabled` condition rather than reading isPending, because a disabled query reports pending forever. 5) Unavailable states are enumerated with one sentence each and the one benign state carries no retry.
